summary: Delivery product is directionally sound and conceptually mature. Strategic foundation (Delivery-as-Code, schema, state policy, rendered packets) is in place. Execution gap persists: the three top priorities — running a real pilot end-to-end, upgrading the gate to a contract, and making measurement operational — remain open and unstarted. No material change since 2026-03-14 nightly pass. Overnight context from 2026-03-15 confirms Delivery signals were recognized but deprioritised against Vega/PXS boundary and TDE assignment-substrate work. No new completions or blockers to record.

topPriorities.title: Run one real Delivery v0.1 pilot end to end and publish the evidence pack
topPriorities.note: Core scaffolding in place; activation and verification path still thin. No execution started on the pilot itself as of this run.
topPriorities.nextStep: Select one representative Delivery v0.1 pilot in PXS, run the full VERIFY path, produce canonical evidence pack.

topPriorities.title: Upgrade the Delivery gate from checklist to contract
topPriorities.note: Gate intent exists; current language is too thin to function as a compiled contract. Risk R-003 (gate ambiguity) remains live.
topPriorities.nextStep: Expand gate into a risk-classed contract with required checks, evidence outputs, pass/fail logic, and at least one machine-checkable validation hook.

topPriorities.title: Make Delivery measurement and review operational, not aspirational
topPriorities.note: Metric intent is clear in METRICS.md. No baseline or real weekly review cadence has been run. Scorecard remains conceptual.
topPriorities.nextStep: Define minimal low-noise weekly scorecard snapshot, run first real weekly review, record one concrete follow-through improvement.
